title: Quantum Multi-Armed Bandits and Linear Bandits: Lower Bounds and Algorithms
summary: We study quantum multi-armed bandits (QMAB) and quantum linear bandits (QLB), where the learner queries each arm or action through a quantum reward oracle or its inverse. Prior work gives algorithms over horizon $T$ with regret $O(K\log T)$ for QMAB with $K$ arms and $O(d^2\operatorname{polylog} T)$ for $d$-dimensional QLB. This leaves open the optimal dependence on $K$ and $T$ and whether the dependence on $d$ can be further improved. In this work, we prove the first tight minimax regret bound of $Θ(K\log(1+T/K))$ for QMAB and the first lower bound of $Ω(d\log(1+T/d))$ for finite-action…
